response.justification: The candidate is a clearly experienced, versatile software engineer with 15+ years across web, backend, and some systems programming, but the profile is a poor match for this role's core requirements. Professional C++ experience is minimal and dated (a ~6-month stint at National Instruments in 2014–2015), and there is no evidence of MQTT, IEC 62443/SDL, industrial automation protocols, or Azure. His low-latency, high-throughput work was in DLang, and recent years have been TypeScript/Node.js product engineering — adjacent, but not the hands-on senior C++ and industrial-cybersecurity depth this position demands.
strengths: Extensive overall engineering experience (15+ years) with strong craftsmanship practices (TDD, CI/CD, pairing)
Real high-performance, low-latency systems work (async I/O, fibers, caching) at Dunnhumby, albeit in DLang
Proven mentorship and knowledge-sharing (workshops, code katas, courses) matching the mentoring responsibility
concerns: Very limited and outdated professional C++/STL experience relative to the core requirement
No industrial cybersecurity background: no IEC 62443, SDL, or protocols like OPC UA, Modbus, DNP 3.0
No demonstrated MQTT/IoT or message-broker-at-scale work in the required C++ context; recent focus is web/full-stack

key_factors.factor: No industrial security (IEC 62443/SDL) or automation-protocol exposure
Strong general engineering seniority and performance-systems background
